infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Polaris Maps needs your location to show your position on the map and provide turn-by-turn navigation directions.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Polaris Maps uses your location in the background to keep turn-by-turn guidance running while the app is closed or your screen is locked, and to contribute anonymous traffic data to the P2P network.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Polaris Maps uses the camera to capture street-level imagery for the community.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Polaris Maps needs access to your photo library to save and share maps, routes, and locations.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Polaris Maps uses speech recognition to enable voice commands for hands-free navigation.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Polaris Maps uses your location in the background to contribute anonymous traffic data.

plugins.cameraPermission: Polaris Maps uses the camera to capture street-level imagery.
